summary: Tested bug fix for discount (iskonto) changes not updating sale_amount_tl. All 5 tests PASSED - the fix is working correctly.

issues: Console warning: Chart width/height -1 - recharts component sizing issue (minor, pre-existing)

passed_tests: TEST 1: Discount value change (10% → 5%) correctly updates sale_amount_tl from ₺519,548.31 to ₺548,412.10
TEST 2: Discount set to 0% correctly makes sale_amount_tl = net_total = calculated_total = ₺577,275.90
TEST 3: Discount type change (% → ₺) correctly updates sale_amount_tl and resets manual_override
TEST 4: After discount change, quantity change (18 → 20) correctly updates all totals (Ara Toplam: ₺591,526.50, Net Toplam: ₺532,373.85, Satış Tutarı: ₺532,373.85)

bug_fix_verification.issue: When discount value or type was changed, sale_amount_tl was not updating automatically
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: manual_override flag was not being reset to false when discount changes occurred
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Added manual_override: false in discount type onValueChange (line 1182) and discount value onChange (line 1201) in Sales.jsx

quantity_after_discount_test.action: Changed quantity from 18 to 20 after setting 10% discount

manual_override_message_test.initial_state: When editing sale, manual_override is true (message visible)

critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix correctly implemented - manual_override: false added to discount type and value change handlers
Line 1182: onValueChange for discount type Select now includes manual_override: false
Line 1201: onChange for discount value Input now includes manual_override: false
Combined with previous fix (iteration_7) for updateItem and removeItem, all scenarios are now covered
seed_data_creation: Used existing sale record: Remzi Rıdvan Çetin (TKL-202602-0039) with 8 items
